findings.text: non-blocking: the quoted red-arm summary line reads "1 failed, 1 warning in 63.77s", a line that appears in no log on disk; the negative-control.log the same fragment cites records "1 failed, 1 warning in 22.42s" with EXIT=1, so the excerpt the fragment presents as that log's tail is from an earlier run, and a reader reconciling the fragment against its log finds a mismatch even though the assertion text and FAILED id do match.

non-blocking: the check passes vacuously when the graph holds zero CORRECTS edges, because checked_edges is only reported and never asserted, so a later loss of the 20 edges the node measured would leave the test green; the disposable-graph arms are what show the live green is not vacuous, and pinning an edge count would make the check brittle against legitimate graph rebuilds.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from base 8466f0e0c to head 09f49e776; 9f4b800b3 adds the yaml slot, the test method and three evidence artifacts, and 09f49e776 only rewrites the evidence script's log-header line to one line, so the code under test is identical across both commits and the gate at 9f4b800b3 covers the head.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for four facts and the gate covers each — the yaml declaration at imas_codex/schemas/standard_name.yaml:3589, the generated tuple ('StandardNameSourceRetry', 'CORRECTS', 'StandardNameSourceRetry', 'one') at imas_codex/graph/schema_context_data.py:2501 with the corrects field at imas_codex/graph/models.py:9092, live.json recording 20 edges across 1 declared pair with 0 mislabelled, and negative-control.log recording the planted StandardNameSource->StandardName edge failing at EXIT=1 while nc-clean.log passes at EXIT=0 on the same disposable graph.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to declare the CORRECTS relationship with its endpoints and add an endpoint-comparing check beside the existing relationship-type check; imas_codex/schemas/standard_name.yaml:3589 declares StandardNameSourceRetry.corrects with range StandardNameSourceRetry and annotation relationship_type: CORRECTS, and tests/graph/test_schema_compliance.py:64 adds test_corrects_edges_join_declared_endpoints inside TestLabelsAndRelationships immediately after test_all_relationship_types_in_schema, so the goal is met exactly.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, the gate recorded as 1 passed EXIT=0, a clean arm at EXIT=0 and a red arm at EXIT=1, and every log it names exists on disk with the stated result, except the red-arm summary time quoted in the evidence fragment, which is a different run's line (see FINDING).
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are imas_codex/schemas/standard_name.yaml, tests/graph/test_schema_compliance.py and the docs/evidence/fragments/sn-pipeline-hygiene/sph-corrects-schema artifacts plus a figures directory; the diff 8466f0e0c..09f49e776 touches five files and every one is inside that set, with the gitignored generated models copied locally and never staged.

justifications.durability: tests/graph/test_schema_compliance.py:74 reads the declared pair from the generated RELATIONSHIPS and reddens when the yaml slot is removed, and :100 compares live graph labels against that pair and is shown red on the planted undeclared edge in negative-control.log, so both assertions are independent of the values the test supplies; it passes vacuously on a graph with zero CORRECTS edges.
justifications.evidence: gate-live.log records "1 passed" EXIT=0 at revision 9f4b800b3 for the named test id and live.json records 20 edges across 1 declared pair with 0 mislabelled, but the fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/sn-pipeline-hygiene/sph-corrects-schema.html:57 quotes a red-arm summary line that its own cited log does not contain.
justifications.fit: the new method, the module-level import guard at tests/graph/test_schema_compliance.py:17-20 mirroring imas_codex/graph/client.py:132-138, and the pytest.mark.graph placement all follow the surrounding file, but the helper _declared_endpoint_pairs at :25 projects the generated tuple list where the schema owner already exposes the same pairs.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/schemas/standard_name.yaml:3589 carries the slot with range StandardNameSourceRetry and relationship_type CORRECTS, and tests/graph/test_schema_compliance.py:64 adds the endpoint assertion exactly where the brief asked, beside test_all_relationship_types_in_schema.
justifications.reuse: the nearest owner of "endpoint pairs for a relationship type" is GraphSchema.relationships at imas_codex/graph/schema.py:109 (the yaml-derived source) with imas_codex/graph/schema_context.py:251 as the other RELATIONSHIPS filter; tests/graph/test_schema_compliance.py:25 duplicates that projection against the generated artefact rather than extending the owner, a deliberate choice because the done_when requires the generated models carry the declaration, and the evidence script properly reuses tests/standard_names/conftest.py::_start_empty_neo4j for its disposable graph.
justifications.scope_discipline: all five paths in 8466f0e0c..09f49e776 are inside the manifest's declared write paths and the second commit touches only the in-scope evidence script.
